RefusalCode.description:
Every refusal, warning and undo-label code the server can send.

**server refusals (shipped wire codes — do not rename)**: `no-state-dir`, `takeover-unsupported`, `no-stagebox-registry`, `invalid-message`, `sip-disarmed`, `sip-needs-confirm`

**stagebox bulk-assignment refusals (core `StageboxAssignError`)**: `stagebox.assign.unknown-device`, `stagebox.assign.no-such-side`, `stagebox.assign.clear-outputs-unsupported`, `stagebox.assign.bad-start-channel`, `stagebox.assign.exceeds-box-width`, `stagebox.assign.exceeds-audio-fabric`

**insert latency-budget findings (core `judgeChainLatency`)**: `insert.latency.exceeds-budget`, `insert.latency.may-exceed-budget`, `insert.latency.unknown-at-rate`, `insert.latency.within-budget`

**engine real-time headroom**: `rt.budget`

**plugin analysis (issue #342)**: `measurement.engine-live`, `measurement.already-running`, `measurement.no-rates`, `measurement.nothing-local`

**the plugin host's instance table (audio-engine `ModHostClient`)**: `plugins.instances-exhausted`

**multitrack record (2026-07-16-recording-vsc.md §2.3)**: `record.already-running`, `record.nothing-armed`, `record.no-space`, `record.no-engine`, `record.rate-unknown`

**the offline HRP render (2026-07-16-recording-vsc.md §0.5)**: `render.no-engine`, `render.no-tracks`, `render.no-space`, `render.already-running`

**the MAIN print export (2026-07-16-recording-vsc.md §0.6)**: `export.no-engine`, `export.no-main`, `export.empty`, `export.unreadable`, `export.no-space`, `export.already-running`, `render.recording`, `render.playback`, `record.vsc-active`

**virtual soundcheck (2026-07-16-recording-vsc.md §3)**: `vsc.no-take`, `vsc.no-track`, `vsc.rate-mismatch`, `vsc.recording`, `vsc.no-such-take`, `vsc.take-unplayable`, `vsc.no-engine`, `vsc.not-engaged`

**discovery blindness: the headline**: `discovery.blind.link`, `discovery.blind.global`

**discovery blindness: why (REAC raw-socket prober)**: `discovery.reac.nic-enumeration-failed`, `discovery.reac.passive-listen-failed`, `discovery.reac.active-probe-failed`, `discovery.reac.link-busy`, `discovery.reac.active-probe-no-reason`

**discovery blindness: why (reac-pw property prober)**: `discovery.reac.registry-unloaded`, `discovery.reac.not-publishing`, `discovery.reac.predates-discovery`, `discovery.reac.unknown-state`, `discovery.reac.unparseable`, `discovery.reac.stale`, `discovery.reac.not-listening-here`

**clock cross-checks (Setup → Clock, and the warnings badge)**: `clock.no-owner.title`, `clock.no-owner.detail`, `clock.two-owners.title`, `clock.two-owners.detail`, `clock.unqualified-master.title`, `clock.synthetic-driver.title`, `clock.synthetic-driver.detail`

**xrun cross-checks (issue #657: warn, with numbers, never block)**: `xrun.growing.title`, `xrun.growing.detail.raise`, `xrun.growing.detail.raise-holder`, `xrun.growing.detail.relax`, `xrun.growing.detail.unknown`

**absent hardware after a session restore**: `hardware.missing.summary`, `hardware.missing.clause-separator`, `hardware.missing.input-patches`, `hardware.missing.output-routes`, `hardware.missing.no-patches`, `hardware.missing.configured-on`, `hardware.missing.not-connected`, `hardware.missing.bridge-down`, `hardware.missing.surface`

**a stored value contradicted by the hardware itself**: `hardware.contradiction.model`, `hardware.contradiction.width`, `hardware.contradiction.channels`

**routing loops (howl-round topology, issue #378)**: `feedback.loop.no-cuttable-edge`

**undo / redo entry labels**: `undo.label.route`, `undo.label.bpm`, `undo.label.stripOrder`, `undo.label.gate`, `undo.label.delay`, `undo.label.reverb`, `undo.label.eq`, `undo.label.paste`, `undo.label.send`

**Undo — per-parameter labels**: `undo.label.set.fader`, `undo.label.set.gain`, `undo.label.set.pan`, `undo.label.set.trim`, `undo.label.set.phantom`, `undo.label.set.polarity`, `undo.label.set.align`, `undo.label.set.name`, `undo.label.set.colour`, `undo.label.set.instrument`

params.description: Named, wire-serialisable scalars only — the exact fields the code’s localised sentence interpolates. Shape varies per code; see the code’s own description.

Refusal.description: A structured refusal: a stable code plus the parameters its sentence needs. The client renders the code in its own locale rather than reading display prose from the server.
